This work is listed in A khu ching Shes rab rgya mtsho's Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 532, no. 11686: zhwa lu rin chen bsod nams 'phel gyi mdzod kyi rnam bshad sde bdun gsal ba'i sgron me).
Date of composition: lcags mo yos kyi lo'i zla ba dad po'i tshes gcig (in the year of the iron-female rat, on the first day of the first Tibetan month)
alternative_names: mngon pa mdzod kyi rnam bshad gsal ba'i sgron me
